title: Save safety workflow
summary: Inspect and protect saves before experiments.
content: Save Manager is inspection, backup, verification, restore preview, and safe restore only. It does not directly edit save contents.

title: Profiles and isolation
summary: Use separate profiles for stable play and research.
content: The Default profile is intended for stable play. The Research profile is an isolated surface for experimental settings and evidence.

title: Module boundaries
summary: Modules use contracts and explicit capability boundaries.
content: Normal workflows can be embedded in Control Center. Trainer, Research, and other higher-risk tools may run as separate processes with an explicit launch context.

title: Evidence before in-game claims
summary: An offline build or registration result does not prove visible in-game behavior.
content: Treat successful validation, packaging, or runtime registration as an intermediate result only. A feature should remain experimental or research-only until the target Enshrouded build has fresh runtime evidence and, where relevant, in-game visual confirmation. Record the build context and limitations before promoting the result.

title: Gameplay settings require an adapter
summary: Staged tuning is portable input, not a direct game mutation.
content: The installation exposes client preference settings but no supported native gameplay-tuning document. EmberVault therefore exports staged profile values and keeps live application behind an explicitly identified mod or tuning adapter that declares its input contract, backup requirements, mutation scope, and verification procedure.

title: Capability status labels
summary: Separate verified, experimental, research-only, and blocked work.
content: Verified route means the documented boundary has passed its evidence requirements. Experimental means controlled testing is possible while important questions remain. Research-only belongs in an isolated profile or disposable world. Blocked means a missing dependency, unsafe boundary, or unresolved failure prevents promotion.

title: Furniture registration is not visual proof
summary: A resource registration route does not prove complete rendering behavior.
content: The recorded furniture research demonstrates an independent ItemInfo registration route for a specific build. Catalog exposure, mesh and texture rendering, multiplayer behavior, and complete visual presentation require separate evidence. Keep the work in a disposable test world while those boundaries remain research-only.
